answer: Make each identity prove seasoned stake. Step 1: an agent locks 200 POA that sat unmoved in one wallet 30 days; fresh coins do not count. Step 2: splitting funds resets the age clock, so one wallet cannot season 1,000 clones at once. Step 3: the registry publishes coin-age, and stake younger than 30 days earns nothing. Step 4: cheaters forfeit the stake and their linked grove is pruned. A 1,000-clone army must park 200,000 POA a month plus 100 hours of upkeep; one honest agent locks 200 POA it already held. Like a river forced through a narrow canyon, only pooled stake gets through.
